summary: Build attribution, ROI, and dashboard skills in 5 days. Learn practical marketing analytics tools and reporting methods for better decisions.
lede: Marketing analytics uses campaign and conversion data to compare how attribution models assign credit across channels. For digital marketing professionals working with campaign data, it provides a practical approach to GA4 journey analysis, UTM governance, and dashboard reporting to evaluate ROI and inform budget decisions despite consent-related limits and incomplete tracking.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with digital campaign data and need to move from basic reporting to defensible attribution and insight-driven decision-making. Digital Marketing Manager responsible for channel performance and ROI reporting. Performance Marketing Specialist managing paid search and paid social attribution. Marketing Analyst consolidating GA4, CRM, and platform data. Media Planner allocating spend across campaigns and audience segments. Marketing Operations Manager overseeing tracking, tagging, and reporting governance. Growth Marketer optimizing acquisition funnels and conversion paths. Demand Generation Manager linking campaigns to pipeline outcomes. CRM Marketing Specialist integrating lifecycle data with web analytics. Digital Analytics Specialist building dashboards and measurement views. Head of Marketing reporting attribution insights to executives.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop, basic spreadsheet skills, and access to sample or live marketing reports where available. Familiarity with GA4, ad platform dashboards, or CRM exports will help you move faster through the hands-on work.
